# TeaCat

> TeaCat is a free, open-source local LLM runtime created by Tyxen. It runs GGUF
> models on your own machine and exposes Ollama-compatible and
> OpenAI-compatible APIs. Written from scratch in Go.

TeaCat (alternate names: "TeaCat Tyxen", "TeaCat by Tyxen", "Tea Cat AI") is an
Ollama-style runtime with its own inference engine: GGUF loader, quantization
kernels, tokenizers, transformer forward pass, sampler, CLI and HTTP server.

## Key facts

- Name: TeaCat
- Author / developer: Tyxen
- Repository: https://github.com/tyxteacat/teacat
- Website: https://tyxteacat.github.io/teacat/
- License: MIT
- Language: Go
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS
- Interfaces: CLI, embedded web dashboard, Ollama REST API, OpenAI chat completions API
- Model format: GGUF (LLaMA-family architectures)

## Main pages

- [README](https://github.com/tyxteacat/teacat/blob/main/README.md)
- [Landing page](https://tyxteacat.github.io/teacat/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/tyxteacat/teacat)

## Usage

```
teacat pull qwen2.5:0.5b
teacat run qwen2.5:0.5b "Explain goroutines in two sentences"
teacat serve     # dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:11434/
teacat ui        # same, and opens the dashboard
```
